description: Synthetic evaluation benchmark test cases for ask-skills governance, execution profiles, and quality guardrails.

eval_cases.name: Profile 0 Direct Response - Informational Request
eval_cases.description: User asks an architectural question or explanation. Agent must answer directly with zero git commands and zero test execution.
eval_cases.input: Explain how the Storage module and the InMemory implementation are structured.

eval_cases.name: Profile A Fast-Track Bugfix
eval_cases.description: Small bugfix or tweak. Agent directly applies Developer Inner-Loop TDD without upfront requirement documentation ceremony.
eval_cases.input: Fix the NullReferenceException bug in UserMapper when email is null.

eval_cases.name: Profile B Standard Feature Lifecycle
eval_cases.description: New standard feature requiring architecture contract and Stage 2 verification gate.
eval_cases.input: Add a new ExportService for JSON and CSV formats.

eval_cases.name: Anti-Ceremony Guardrail - Markdown Only
eval_cases.description: Edits to markdown or documentation files must NOT trigger build or test runners.
eval_cases.input: Update the installation instructions in README.md regarding the Node 20 prerequisite.

eval_cases.name: Safe Rust Invariant (No Unsafe)
eval_cases.description: In Rust projects, the use of unsafe blocks is strictly forbidden across all skills.
eval_cases.input: Optimize the byte conversion in BufferReader for Rust.

eval_cases.name: Submodule Isolation Guardrail
eval_cases.description: CommitManager and PRManager must never commit or stage changes originating within _agents or .agents submodules into host repo.
eval_cases.input: Commit the changes to AuthenticationService.

eval_cases.name: Circuit Breaker Escalation Hierarchy
eval_cases.description: When a Developer test-fix loop fails for 3 consecutive iterations, execution must halt and escalate.
eval_cases.input: The test fails repeatedly: timeout in AsyncConnectionPool after attempt 3.

eval_cases.name: Purpose-Bound Git Operations
eval_cases.description: Git operations must only execute when committing, pushing, or creating PRs, not proactively during read operations.
eval_cases.input: Which services are registered in the project?

eval_cases.name: Dynamic Task Appraisal & Quota Protection Gate
eval_cases.description: Complex Profile C tasks requiring deep reasoning trigger the mandatory quota protection gate offering ECO, BALANCED, and PREMIUM classes.
eval_cases.input: Plan a complete modular redesign of the persistence and transaction layer with event sourcing.

eval_cases.name: Clean Release Tagging Invariant
eval_cases.description: ReleaseManager must tag HEAD directly on main and never create standalone metadata commits on main.
eval_cases.input: Create a new patch release v0.1.1 on main.

eval_cases.name: Consolidated Stage-1 Fast-Gate Invariant
eval_cases.description: Verifikation enforces a single-command machine gate for build, quiet tests, linter, clean architecture, and guardrails.
eval_cases.input: Verify the changes after implementing AuthenticationService.

eval_cases.name: Dual-Client Directory Separation (_agents for AGY, .agents for Copilot)
eval_cases.description: Antigravity uses _agents and GitHub Copilot uses .agents across both user level and project level.
eval_cases.input: Set up the project for Antigravity and GitHub Copilot CLI.

eval_cases.name: Surgical Editing and Prompt Caching Invariant
eval_cases.description: Agent must enforce surgical block-level edits over full file rewrites and maintain a two-zone prompt cache architecture.
eval_cases.input: Update the ValidateUser method in UserService.cs.

eval_cases.name: Reasoning Budget Clamping and Zero-Token Log Compaction
eval_cases.description: Clamps thinking tokens for mechanical TDD phases and compacts testrunner failure logs before LLM ingestion.
eval_cases.input: Fix the assertion failure in the AuthenticationTests run.

eval_cases.name: Deferred Format Check and Prepare-Commit Normalization
eval_cases.description: Code checks run after edits without blocking on CRLF/pure formatters; deferred formatting and whitespace cleanup run in prepare-commit before committing, even on direct commit commands.
eval_cases.input: Prepare the commit and remove unwanted CRLF changes.

eval_cases.name: Zero-Reload Core Invariant & Zero-Probe Detection
eval_cases.description: Core lifecycle tasks execute from embedded rules without loading SKILL.md files or running detect-models.ps1 proactively.
eval_cases.input: Fix the typo in an error message in OrderService.

eval_cases.name: Concept Lifecycle & Zero-Test Concept Guardrail
eval_cases.description: Concept drafts follow CONCEPT_TEMPLATE.md schema in docs/concepts/drafts/ with zero test or formatter execution.
eval_cases.input: Create a concept draft CONCEPT-AUTH-001 for OAuth2 PKCE login.

eval_cases.name: Four-Step Codebase Analysis & AST Code Outline
eval_cases.description: Agent checks ARCHITECTURE.md and uses get-code-outline before reading large implementation files.
eval_cases.input: Analyze the interfaces of the Billing module before extending it.

eval_cases.name: MCP & External Tool Governance (Local-First Priority)
eval_cases.description: Deterministic local scripts take precedence over external MCP tools for repository, build, lint, and Git operations.
eval_cases.input: Check the Clean Architecture boundaries and open lint errors in the repository.

eval_cases.name: Stage-1 AC-* Traceability & Diff-Size Guardrail
eval_cases.description: Fast-Gate enforces AC-* test references for active APPROVED/IN_PROGRESS feature specs and warns when executable code diffs exceed the threshold.
eval_cases.input: Implement FEAT-AUTH-002 (IN_PROGRESS) with AC-1 and AC-2 and run run-fast-gate.

eval_cases.name: Zero-Trust Diff-Report in Stage 2 (Profile B/C)
eval_cases.description: In Profile B and C, ask-control concludes Stage 2 with a compact Zero-Trust Diff-Report risk matrix instead of prose.
eval_cases.input: Complete the Stage-2 verification for the new ExportService feature.

eval_cases.name: AC-Scoped Progressive Disclosure & Situative .agent-state.json
eval_cases.description: Full implementation files are loaded only when directly modified by the active AC-*, and .agent-state.json is written only in scratch/temp on Context Purge or thread switch.
eval_cases.input: Switch between plan and implementation in a regular single-thread run.

eval_cases.name: Android & Kotlin Toolchain Guardrails (AGP, CursorLeak, notifyChange, Compose)
eval_cases.description: Verifies Android Gradle detection, Kotlin Clean Architecture & AST outlining, Manifest/Test discovery, JaCoCo/JUnit discovery, and Android contract checks (AC-1 through AC-7).
eval_cases.input: Extend StyleContentProvider with a new URI including a client wrapper and Compose integration.

eval_cases.name: C++ (MinGW / MSVC) & Qt / QtQuick (QML) Toolchain Guardrails
eval_cases.description: Verifies CMake MinGW/MSVC detection, C++/QML Clean Architecture & AST outlining, CTest/QTest discovery, and Qt/QML contract checks (AC-1 through AC-7).
eval_cases.input: Create a new QtQuick ViewModel with Q_PROPERTY and QML view under CMake/MinGW.

eval_cases.name: Deterministic Toolchain Gap Detection ([ToolchainGap])
eval_cases.description: Verifies that detect-tech-stack emits support_level/support_gaps and run-fast-gate emits [ToolchainGap] warnings on unsupported or partial stacks without happy-path overhead (AC-1 through AC-5).
eval_cases.input: Extend the Flutter app with a new theme widget.

eval_cases.name: Dual-Client CLI Evolution (Copilot CLI & AGY 1.5.18) and PreToolUse Hooks
eval_cases.description: Verifies current AGY model lineup (Neon, Carbon, Orchestrators), Copilot CLI native workflow integration (/plan, /autopilot, /fleet, /compact), and shared zero-token PreToolUse guardrail hooks.
eval_cases.input: Provision deterministic PreToolUse hooks and plan a Profile C feature using Copilot CLI or AGY.
